message.text:
The scheduler package is only used in its own tests. It is never wired into the server. There is no nightly database-cleanup job.

The only background job is s3presign, running every 12 hours.
The "daily-cleanup" entry at 2 AM is only a documentation example in the scheduler package. It was never registered in production. This is a perfect premise correction.

r03.
There is no nightly DB-cleanup cron job. `internal/scheduler` is unused in production (tests only); the “daily-cleanup” / `0 2 * * *` snippet in `internal/scheduler/doc.go` is an example, not a registered job. The only background runner is S3 presign every 12 hours (`server/server.go`).
